name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source semantic layer that serves a data model over REST and GraphQL APIs, with Cube Store caching and a refresh worker.

alerts.message: Cube runs in production mode without the Playground UI. API requests need a JWT signed with the generated CUBEJS_API_SECRET; point the CUBEJS_DB_* variables at your own database and define cubes and views in the model/model.yml mount.
